## README.md
# Soft Commodity Infrastructure (Brazil)

Where Brazilian farms connect to markets. This is the geolocated midstream of
Brazilian agriculture: the silos, slaughterhouses, dairy plants, and
sugar/ethanol mills that farms sell into, plus the cooperatives that farms
belong to. It exists to answer, for any rural property, **who to contact** about
deforestation on the land — the cooperative that has the farmer as a member, or
the buyer that receives their grain, cattle, or cane.

Brazil only. 83,811 rows across seven GeoParquet files, describing 40,669
distinct entities. All geometry is WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

## What is here

One collection,
[facilities](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/collection.json),
with seven files.

| File | Rows | What it is |
|---|---:|---|
| `BR_facilities` | 40,669 | The unified layer. Every entity, one row, all five tiers. **Start here.** |
| `BR_intake_points` | 18,802 | Grain silos from CONAB, with source GPS coordinates and capacity in tonnes |
| `BR_sisbi_points` | 11,582 | State and municipal slaughterhouses and dairy plants (SIE/SIM/CONSORCIO) |
| `BR_muni` | 5,570 | IBGE municipality boundaries |
| `BR_membership_muni` | 5,257 | Cooperative-member farm counts per municipality (IBGE 2017) |
| `BR_buyer_points` | 1,514 | Federally inspected (SIF) slaughterhouses and dairy plants |
| `BR_mill_points` | 417 | Sugar and ethanol mills from ANP |

`BR_facilities` is a union of the other six plus 3,103 modelled catchment
polygons, so the seven row counts overlap. Do not add them together and call the
result a facility count.

Tiers inside `BR_facilities`, measured over all 40,669 rows:

| `tier` | Rows | |
|---|---:|---|
| `intake_point` | 18,796 | grain silos |
| `slaughter_point` | 13,096 | animal-product buyers, SIF plus SISBI |
| `membership_muni` | 5,257 | cooperative-member density, as municipality polygons |
| `gravity_catchment` | 3,103 | modelled silo draw-areas — the only `modelled` rows |
| `mill_point` | 417 | sugar and ethanol mills |

## How it was made

Every point comes from a government registry, or is geocoded from one. Nothing
is guessed from satellite imagery.

- **Grain silos** — CONAB's national warehouse registry
  (`ArmazensCadastrados`), which every grain warehouse must register with. It
  ships real GPS coordinates, so these are exact.
- **Slaughterhouses and dairy plants, federal** — MAPA's SIF registry. It has
  the company, tax ID, and address but no coordinates, so the addresses were
  geocoded.
- **Slaughterhouses and dairy plants, state and municipal** — the smaller local
  plants the federal list misses. These live in MAPA's SISBI system, which has
  no bulk download. Trase pulled the SISBI records and geocoded them from the
  registry addresses.
- **Sugar and ethanol mills** — ANP's ethanol producer list. No street address,
  so each mill sits at its town's centre.
- **Cooperative membership** — IBGE's Censo Agropecuário 2017, counting how many
  farms in each município belong to a cooperative. A density signal, not a named
  cooperative, but it works even in remote frontier towns.
- **Municipality geometry** — IBGE's official município boundaries.

## Trust labels on every row

Not every point is equally precise, so each row carries two labels.

`basis` is `observed` (37,566 rows) or `modelled` (3,103 rows, the gravity
catchments only).

`geom_method` records how the coordinate was set. Five values occur:

| `geom_method` | Rows | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `registered` | 18,796 | the source supplied the GPS coordinate |
| `geocoded` | 12,007 | an address was turned into a point, and can be off |
| `municipality` | 5,257 | the row is the municipality polygon itself |
| `derived` | 3,103 | a modelled catchment area |
| `municipality_centroid` | 1,506 | all that was available was the town |

## Access

No credentials. The files are plain HTTPS GeoParquet, so DuckDB reads them in
place. This query was run against the published files:

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

SELECT tier, count(*) AS n
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/BR_facilities.parquet'
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY n DESC;
```

```
             tier     n
     intake_point 18796
  slaughter_point 13096
  membership_muni  5257
gravity_catchment  3103
       mill_point   417
```

The five nearest grain silos to Sinop, Mato Grosso:

```sql
SELECT operator, municipio_nome, uf, capacity_t,
       round(ST_Distance_Sphere(geometry, ST_Point(-55.5024, -11.8642)) / 1000, 1) AS km
FROM 'https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/facilities/BR_intake_points.parquet'
ORDER BY km
LIMIT 5;
```

```
                           operator municipio_nome uf  capacity_t  km
C.VALE - COOPERATIVA AGROINDUSTRIAL       SINOP-MT MT     33070.0 2.5
C.VALE - COOPERATIVA AGROINDUSTRIAL       SINOP-MT MT     33950.0 2.5
             AGENOR VICENTE PELISSA       SINOP-MT MT      7430.0 3.3
               CARGILL AGRICOLA S A       SINOP-MT MT     63620.0 4.2
               CARGILL AGRICOLA S A       SINOP-MT MT     63450.0 4.2
```

**Do not wrap `geometry` in `ST_GeomFromWKB`.** DuckDB's spatial extension reads
the GeoParquet geometry column as `GEOMETRY('OGC:CRS84')` already, and
`ST_GeomFromWKB` on it raises a binder error. Use the column directly.

More worked queries, the join keys, and the traps are in
[AGENTS.md](https://data.source.coop/tristangruppwri/soft-commodity-infrastructure/AGENTS.md).

## Provenance

This is the official publication from the World Resources Institute, not a
mirror. WRI compiled, geocoded, unified and published it. The underlying records
belong to CONAB, MAPA (SIF and SISBI), ANP, IBGE, and Trase, each credited as a
producer in the collection metadata.

Pipeline, tests, and a plain-language writeup live at
[github.com/wri/rural-land](https://github.com/wri/rural-land), under
`soft_commodity_infrastructure/METHODOLOGY.md`.

The snapshot was compiled on 2026-07-23. CONAB's registry drifts daily; exact
source snapshot dates are recorded in the pipeline repository.

## Known limits

- Geocoded and municipality-centroid points are approximate. A geocode can land
  on the wrong lot, and a centroid sits at the middle of the town.
- Cooperative membership is a per-município count, not a named cooperative.
  313 of the 5,570 municipalities carry no membership row at all.
- Rice, cotton, and coffee are not covered. No authoritative open geolocated
  source exists for them.
- Three municipality geometries fail an OGC validity test (self-intersection).
  They are published unrepaired, as received from IBGE.
